examples.purpose: A row of quotes, the guide's In context: a Title over a row that scrolls sideways, each card keeping its 180 px. Each card shows the customer's initials through avatarProps' monogram, opens that customer's full review through onPress (the empty handler stands for opening it), and has an accessibilityLabel that says where it goes. ScrollArea has no entry in this pack; it is the horizontal scroller the guide's In context uses.
examples.jsx:
<VStack>
  <Title title="What customers say" subtitle="From people who switched this year" />
  <ScrollArea direction="horizontal">
    <HStack alignVertical="flex-start">
      <TestimonialsCard
        title="Aarav S."
        body="Renewing my car insurance took a minute."
        avatarProps={{ monogram: 'AS' }}
        onPress={() => {}}
        accessibilityLabel="Read Aarav S.’s full review"
      />
      <TestimonialsCard
        title="Priya M."
        body="Simple, fast, reliable."
        avatarProps={{ monogram: 'PM' }}
        onPress={() => {}}
        accessibilityLabel="Read Priya M.’s full review"
      />
      <TestimonialsCard
        title="Rohan K."
        body="Setting up my first SIP took less than two minutes."
        avatarProps={{ monogram: 'RK' }}
        onPress={() => {}}
        accessibilityLabel="Read Rohan K.’s full review"
      />
      <TestimonialsCard
        title="Neha J."
        body="I see all my accounts and my gold in one place now."
        avatarProps={{ monogram: 'NJ' }}
        onPress={() => {}}
        accessibilityLabel="Read Neha J.’s full review"
      />
    </HStack>
  </ScrollArea>
</VStack>

props.name: title
props.description: 14 px on a 16 px line, 2 px above the quote. Declared: The testimonial heading, typically the author's name. Default "Title", from the component source.

props.name: body
props.default: I was dreading renewing my car insurance, but JioFinance made it a breeze.
props.description: Wraps: a one-line card is 180 × 112, and two quote lines give 128. Declared: The testimonial body copy. Default "I was dreading renewing my car insurance, but JioFinance made it a breeze.", from the component source.

props.name: modes
props.description: Mode configuration passed to the token resolver. Also forwarded to the Avatar child for consistent theming.

props.name: style
props.description: Optional style overrides for the card container.

props.name: avatarProps
props.description: monogram alone shows the initials; without avatarProps the initials come from the title; imageSource shows a photo. avatarProps.modes merge with the card's modes, and the avatar's own Avatar Size wins. Declared: Props forwarded to the Avatar component (e.g. a custom `imageSource`). Card `modes` are defaults; `avatarProps.modes` win. A `monogram` without `style` uses `style: 'Monogram'` so the stock photo does not appear.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Left out, the card reads once as “Testimonial from <title>: <body>”. Declared: Accessibility label for the card region. Falls back to a label generated from the title and body.

props.name: onPress
props.description: The card dims to 0.7 while pressed; Enter and Space press it; no hover look. Declared: Press handler for the whole card. When set, the card becomes pressable (rendered through a `Pressable` with `accessibilityRole="button"`).

props.name: disabled
props.description: With onPress: 0.5 opacity, aria-disabled and tabindex -1 on the web. Without onPress it leaves a static card alone. Declared: Disable interaction when `onPress` is set. Also dims the card.
